subject.title: feat: report Pi and OpenCode in guided setup

question: Should guided setup permanently enumerate installed Pi and OpenCode harness CLIs in the core informational inventory even though neither is a selectable inference route?
rationale: The implementation is sound, but adding owner-specific executable names and explanatory policy to the core setup inventory is a product-boundary choice covered by the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Approve informational inventory
options.body: Land the shared detector and documentation as written, keeping both harnesses explicitly non-selectable.

options.title: Keep inference routes only
options.body: Remove Pi and OpenCode from guided setup and leave harness discovery to their dedicated runtime or plugin surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve informational inventory
recommendation.body: Land the shared detector and documentation as written, keeping both harnesses explicitly non-selectable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent onboarding-area history and direct authorship make this the strongest available owner for the intended guided-setup inventory policy.
